pr_comments: Hey there @bdraco, mind taking a look at this pull request as it has been labeled with an integration (`oncue`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L799) for? Thanks!
I need to perform one more round of system testing by disconnecting the ethernet from the Generator.  I will do that later today.

Testing complete all sensors went unavailable and then came back.   One exception is Battery Voltage, where is the messages sent back they give a value of Zero.  This can be fixed by using the NetworkConnectionEstablished data as the availability trigger.

Here is what it looks like after I disconnected ethernet cable.  Seems to happen within a minute or two.

![oncue available](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76050312/196997680-605ea1d4-d210-450b-97fd-3917e4333ebe.PNG)

issue_context.title: Oncue data does not go unavailable when genset disconnected
issue_context.body:

When the generator loses connection to the Kohler Oncue Cloud; the data is reported back in home assistant as "--". The data should be unavailable instead.

I have a pull request for this issue.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.9.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

oncue

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/oncue/
